																		ONGC Geologists and Engineers Exam Pattern 2026

																		1. Selection Process Overview

																		
																			
																			Three Stages: The process consists of a Computer Based Test (CBT), a Personal Interview, and a Medical Fitness examination.
																			
																			
																			Group Discussion: Shortlisted candidates may face a Group Discussion, but it is not of qualifying nature.
																			
																			
																			Final Weightage (Total: 100 Marks):

																			
																				
																				CBT Score: 85 marks
																				
																				
																				Interview: 15 marks
																				
																			
																			
																		

																		2. Computer Based Test (CBT) Details

																		
																			
																			Format: Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQ), 2 hours total duration.
																			
																			
																			Question Distribution (85 Questions Total):

																			
																				
																				Concerned Domain (Petroleum/Mechanical/Chemical/Instrumentation/Geology): 40 questions
																				
																				
																				Aptitude Test: 25 questions
																				
																				
																				General Awareness: 10 questions
																				
																				
																				English Language: 10 questions
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Negative Marking: There is no negative marking.
																			
																			
																			CBT Qualifying Cut-offs:

																			
																				
																				General / EWS / OBC: Minimum 45% marks
																				
																				
																				SC / ST / PwBD: Minimum 40% marks
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Shortlisting Ratio: Candidates are shortlisted for the interview in a 1:5 ratio based on their CBT performance.
																			
																		

																		3. Personal Interview Requirements

																		
																			
																			Interview Qualifying Cut-offs:

																			
																				
																				General / EWS / OBC: Minimum 60% marks (09 out of 15 marks)
																				
																				
																				SC / ST / PwBD: Minimum 40% marks (06 out of 15 marks)
																				
																			
																			
																		

																		4. Merit List & Final Appointment

																		
																			
																			Tie-Breaking Criteria: In case of equal total scores, the candidate with a higher CBT score is prioritized. If CBT scores are also tied, the older candidate is placed higher.
																			
																			
																			Medical Fitness: Qualified candidates from the interview are arranged by rank for a mandatory Medical Examination.
																			
																			
																			Final Offer: An 'Offer of Appointment' is issued only to candidates who are declared medically fit according to ONGC rules.
																			
																		
																		
																	
																	
																					
																	
																	
																		
																		Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

																		
																			
																			Pay Scale: Rs.60,000 – 1,80,000/- E-1
																			
																			
																			Selection Process: Selection on the Basis of CBT Exam, Interview & Medical Fitness (The candidates must go through the medical fitness standards laid down under ONGC Medical Examination of Employees Rules

																			Three Stages: The process consists of a Computer Based Test (CBT), a Personal Interview, and a Medical Fitness examination.

																				Interview: 15 marks

																			Format: Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQ), 2 hours total duration.
																			
																			
																			Question Distribution (85 Questions Total):

																			
																				
																				Concerned Domain (Petroleum/Mechanical/Chemical/Instrumentation/Geology): 40 questions

																				General Awareness: 10 questions
																				
																				
																				English Language: 10 questions
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Negative Marking: There is no negative marking.
																			
																			
																			CBT Qualifying Cut-offs:

																			
																				
																				General / EWS / OBC: Minimum 45% marks
																				
																				
																				SC / ST / PwBD: Minimum 40% marks
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Shortlisting Ratio: Candidates are shortlisted for the interview in a 1:5 ratio based on their CBT performance.
																			
																		

																		3. Personal Interview Requirements

																		
																			
																			Interview Qualifying Cut-offs:

																			
																				
																				General / EWS / OBC: Minimum 60% marks (09 out of 15 marks)
																				
																				
																				SC / ST / PwBD: Minimum 40% marks (06 out of 15 marks)
																				
																			
																			
																		

																		4. Merit List & Final Appointment

																		
																			
																			Tie-Breaking Criteria: In case of equal total scores, the candidate with a higher CBT score is prioritized. If CBT scores are also tied, the older candidate is placed higher.

																			Final Offer: An 'Offer of Appointment' is issued only to candidates who are declared medically fit according to ONGC rules.

																		ONGC Geologists and Engineers Exam Pattern 2026

																		1. Selection Process Overview

																		
																			
																			Three Stages: The process consists of a Computer Based Test (CBT), a Personal Interview, and a Medical Fitness examination.

																			Final Weightage (Total: 100 Marks):

																			
																				
																				CBT Score: 85 marks
																				
																				
																				Interview: 15 marks
																				
																			
																			
																		

																		2. Computer Based Test (CBT) Details

																		
																			
																			Format: Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQ), 2 hours total duration.
																			
																			
																			Question Distribution (85 Questions Total):

																			
																				
																				Concerned Domain (Petroleum/Mechanical/Chemical/Instrumentation/Geology): 40 questions
																				
																				
																				Aptitude Test: 25 questions
																				
																				
																				General Awareness: 10 questions
																				
																				
																				English Language: 10 questions
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Negative Marking: There is no negative marking.
																			
																			
																			CBT Qualifying Cut-offs:

																			
																				
																				General / EWS / OBC: Minimum 45% marks
																				
																				
																				SC / ST / PwBD: Minimum 40% marks
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Shortlisting Ratio: Candidates are shortlisted for the interview in a 1:5 ratio based on their CBT performance.
																			
																		

																		3. Personal Interview Requirements

																		
																			
																			Interview Qualifying Cut-offs:

																			
																				
																				General / EWS / OBC: Minimum 60% marks (09 out of 15 marks)
																				
																				
																				SC / ST / PwBD: Minimum 40% marks (06 out of 15 marks)
																				
																			
																			
																		

																		4. Merit List & Final Appointment

																		
																			
																			Tie-Breaking Criteria: In case of equal total scores, the candidate with a higher CBT score is prioritized. If CBT scores are also tied, the older candidate is placed higher.
																			
																			
																			Medical Fitness: Qualified candidates from the interview are arranged by rank for a mandatory Medical Examination.
																			
																			
																			Final Offer: An 'Offer of Appointment' is issued only to candidates who are declared medically fit according to ONGC rules.

																			Pay Scale: Rs.60,000 – 1,80,000/- E-1
